text:
Devin: FYI weekly regional GPU capacity check. Keep updates to 1-2 lines.

Maya: us-west-2 / orca-west: baseline 67% -> predicted spike Tue 16:00-20:00 UTC due to customer X. Projected peak 89-93%. Proposal: pre-warm +10 GPUs (1 A100 + 1 A10 equiv) 2h prior to spike. Egress on that pod hits p99 above 9.5Gbps.

Liam: cost calc: ~ $9.6/GPU-hr for A100 reserved. 10 GPUs for 8h ~= $768. Soft throttle available: `egress-throttle set-orca 9.2Gbps` to protect tail latency.

Hana: ap-southeast-1 / lotus-apac: planned rack maintenance Wed 01:00-04:00 UTC. Expect ~9% capacity reduction. Affected private pools: tenant-d.

Sofia: tenant-d owner here. Prefer failover during window. Warmup for our models ~40m. Can we pre-warm eu-central and cutover staged?

Maya: Yes. Recommend pre-warm eu-central 60m prior, reserve 2 on-demand nodes to avoid spot IO issues. ops-bot, schedule pre-warm + failover.

ops-bot: maintenance scheduled id=mt-20260610-11 window=2026-06-10T01:00:00Z-2026-06-10T04:00:00Z actions=[prewarm-euc-60m, staged-failover, switchback] reminders=[60m,15m] link=https://playbook.internal/mt-20260610-11

Jae: us-east-1 / aurora-east: steady 44% -> product release Fri 18:00-22:00 UTC +30% traffic. I can bump autoscale min 6->9 for window. Cold-start penalty ~0.35s.

Liam: Also flag: eu-central spot pool has IO variance; prefer on-demand for short windows. `reserve-nodes --zone eu-central --type on-demand --count 2 --ttl 4h`

Devin: Finance update: ops buffer $10k. Estimated cost for week actions ~ $2.2k. Approve but keep windows tight.

Action items:
- Maya: pre-warm +10 GPUs orca-west Tue 14:00-22:00 UTC; scale back if prefix-cache reduces load. (owner: Maya)
- Maya: reserve 2 on-demand nodes in eu-central for tenant-d Wed maintenance. (owner: Maya)
- Jae: bump aurora-east min nodes to 9 for Fri release. (owner: Jae)
- Liam: monitor orca-west egress and enable soft throttle at 9.2Gbps if needed. (owner: Liam)
- Hana: shift batch retrains off-peak; ETA 6h for config update. (owner: Hana)
- ops-bot: post reminders and maintenance. (owner: ops-bot)

Maya: I'll alert #incidents if orca-west >91% sustained for 20m.

Liam: Quick mitigation if spikes: `rlimit batch_jobs 0.2` to shed batch load (~15% peak relief).
